children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Read online capacity, maintain whitelist and ban state, and communicate moderation changes without surprising active players.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Confirm the exact player identity before changing access; display names may be ambiguous across games and identity modes.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Online is live capacity; whitelist and ban totals are persistent access state.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Compare unusual counts with console and game logs.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Do not treat whitelist or ban totals as current connections.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Resolve exact identity; Steam names need a Web API key (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Each moderation action should be deliberate, auditable, and verified by the game.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Whitelist only when enforcement is enabled or intentionally staged.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Removing whitelist access may not disconnect an online player.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Add or remove a ban, then verify the command or file update succeeded.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Broadcast and save before maintenance, then verify player count, reconnect behavior, access totals, and audit history.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Confirm player identity and current connection/access state

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Apply one whitelist or ban action and verify game acceptance

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Broadcast + save before disruption; test reconnect and audit afterward

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
